recent_en: The company has made several 'OTHERS' announcements recently without details, along with changes in company secretary. News reports that its Singapore-listed unit has recorded three consecutive years of losses. The latest financial results show revenue down 22.2% year-on-year and net loss widened to MYR10.86 million.

Change of Company Secretary K Jayavathani A/P Kanagaratnam on 31 Oct 2026.
Singapore-listed unit recorded three consecutive years of losses.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net loss of MYR10.86 million, with net margin widening from 15.9% to 20.5%.
Singapore-listed unit has been loss-making for three consecutive years.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR52.88 million, down 22.2% year-on-year and 2.1% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR10.86 million with a net margin of 20.5%, wider than 15.9% in the previous quarter.
